verdicts.reason: A keeps the wordmark as the dominant element, but the circle is stretched into a cropped ellipse that runs off the top, right and bottom edges, the 'Fig' descender collides with the ellipse edge, and the tagline is crammed against the right edge. B buries the logo: it is tiny and jammed against the left edge. The distorted ellipse framing the tagline becomes the focal point, so the hierarchy is reversed, and the right third of the canvas is dead space.
